sentences.zh: 他不怕回答。

sentences.en: And the convention is that we don't ask him questions during that moment.
sentences.zh: 他开场就点名了对方，并说他不怕特朗普政府。

sentences.en: It's more about just making small talk and meet and greet.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: But, of course, this moment was an opportunity we didn't want to lose.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Once he started walking up and down the aisles, many of us asked him questions about his response to that Truth Social poSt.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: I have no fear of neither of the Trump administration nor of speaking out loudly about the message of the gospel.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: He was not afraid of answering.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: He opened up by naming him and saying he was not afraid of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: He made it very clear who he was responding to.
sentences.zh: 他非常明确地表达了他在回应谁。

sentences.en: I don't want to get into a debate with him.
sentences.zh: 我不想和他进行辩论。

sentences.en: I don't think that the message of the gospel is meant to be abused in the way that some people are doing.
sentences.zh: 我不认为福音的信息应该像某些人那样被滥用。

sentences.en: And I will continue to speak out loud.
sentences.zh: 而且我会继续大声疾呼。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was a pretty forceful response.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个非常有力的回应。

sentences.en: And I remember when I saw it, the thing that struck me was actually what he said about how someone had to stand up for all these innocent people who were being killed.
sentences.zh: 我记得当我看到它时，真正打动我的是他所说的关于必须有人站出来保护所有这些被杀害的无辜民众的话。

sentences.en: It was almost like he was sort of taking the mantle of moral authority and saying, this is my position.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像他承担起了道德权威的重任，并宣称这就是我的立场。

sentences.en: This is what I'm here to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我来此的目的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: I mean, I think he said something along the lines of this is what I'm here to do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想他说了类似这就是我来此的目的之类的话。

sentences.en: This is my job to speak about the gospel's teachings.
sentences.zh: 宣扬福音的教义是我的职责。

sentences.en: And one of the things that he has said all along is that as Catholics and as humans, we should all stand up for the most vulnerable among us.
sentences.zh: 他一直以来所说的一点是，作为天主教徒和人类，我们都应该为我们中最脆弱的群体挺身而出。

sentences.en: So he's very clearly sees himself as an important moral voice in the world.
sentences.zh: 所以他非常清楚地将自己视为世界上重要的道德声音。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, I know this was extraordinary in your world, but in the context of American politics in 2026, I have to say the Pope's comments,
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，我知道这在你们的世界里非同寻常，但在2026年美国政治的背景下，我不得不说教皇的评论，

sentences.en: they sound pretty mild overall.
sentences.zh: 总的来说听起来相当温和。

sentences.en: We're used to flamethrowers.
sentences.zh: 我们已经习惯了那些言辞激进的人。

sentences.en: And so I'm wondering, why is this such a big deal?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，为什么这件事会引起这么大的轰动？

sentences.en: Well, I think part of it is that he's not a flamethrower, that Pope Leo is, unlike Francis,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想部分原因是他不是那种言辞激进的人，利奥教皇与方济各不同，

sentences.en: not someone who's necessarily eager or willing to engage in fights just for the sake of it.
sentences.zh: 他并不是那种为了争斗而争斗的人，也不一定渴望或愿意卷入争端。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't think that's a totally fair assessment of Francis's personality, but he was very colorful.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不认为这是对方济各性格完全公平的评价，但他确实非常鲜明。

sentences.en: He was willing to be pointed and barbed and speak off the cuff and make dramatic gestures.
sentences.zh: 他愿意直言不讳、言辞犀利，即兴发言并做出戏剧性的姿态。

sentences.en: And, you know, frankly, that was one of the conservative criticisms of him was that they thought he was more performative than anything else.
sentences.zh: 而且，坦率地说，保守派对他的批评之一就是认为他更多是在作秀。

sentences.en: And Leo is the direct opposite of that.
sentences.zh: 而利奥则与此截然相反。

sentences.en: He is very quiet.
sentences.zh: 他非常安静。

sentences.en: He's very mild-mannered.
sentences.zh: 他举止非常温和。

sentences.en: He sticks to his prepared remarks.
sentences.zh: 他坚持按照准备好的讲稿发言。

sentences.en: This is not necessarily someone you think of as spontaneous, always up for a fight.
sentences.zh: 他并不一定是你认为的那种自发、随时准备战斗的人。

sentences.en: And so the fact that someone who has that reputation and temperament is willing to say the things that he said, that he's not afraid of the Trump administration,
sentences.zh: 因此，一个拥有这种声誉和性格的人愿意说出他所说的话，他不惧怕特朗普政府，

sentences.en: that he's speaking up for the people who are most vulnerable, at a moment when he's been attacked, he's sort of not taking the bait in a way.
sentences.zh: 他在自己受到攻击时为最脆弱的人群发声，在某种程度上，他没有上钩。

sentences.en: I think that almost makes his speech more powerful.
sentences.zh: 我认为这几乎让他的演讲更有力量。

sentences.en: It's certainly a contraSt.
sentences.zh: 这当然是一种对比。

sentences.en: Like, if someone is always doing this, it's hard for it to stand out.
sentences.zh: 就像如果一个人总是这样做，就很难脱颖而出。

sentences.en: But when someone who rarely does this suddenly does it, I think it really does stand out.
sentences.zh: 但当一个很少这样做的人突然这样做时，我认为它确实非常引人注目。

sentences.en: And it's worth saying, right, that the Pope is also extremely popular.
sentences.zh: 而且值得一提的是，教皇也非常受欢迎，对吧？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: I think he was very shrewd, if you will, at the beginning of his papacy that he took his time.
sentences.zh: 我认为他在教皇任期之初非常精明，他花了一些时间。

sentences.en: He didn't make a lot of broad gestures, but some of the gestures he did actually endeared him to the conservatives who had been alienated by Francis.
sentences.zh: 他没有做出很多大动作，但他所做的一些举动实际上赢得了那些曾被方济各疏远的保守派的好感。

sentences.en: So on the moment when he came out on the balcony, he was wearing the red Mosetta, this cape that Francis never wore.
sentences.zh: 所以当他出现在阳台上时，他穿着红色的肩衣，这是方济各从未穿过的斗篷。

sentences.en: So that showed he was respectful of the papal traditions.
sentences.zh: 这表明他尊重教皇的传统。

sentences.en: He speaks Latin.
sentences.zh: 他会说拉丁语。

sentences.en: He allowed one of the more conservative United States cardinals to say mass in Latin in St. Peter's Basilica.
sentences.zh: 他允许美国一位比较保守的红衣主教在圣彼得大教堂用拉丁语主持弥撒。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the heart of the Roman Catholic Church right there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那正是罗马天主教会的核心所在。

sentences.en: So he's really kind of extended an olive branch to the conservatives.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实向保守派伸出了橄榄枝。

sentences.en: He showed that he doesn't want to be partisan within the Catholic Church, much less in politics.
sentences.zh: 他表明他不想在天主教会内部搞党派之争，更不用说在政治上了。

sentences.en: He's been a uniter among Catholics, whereas Francis was willing to kind of say provocative things.
sentences.zh: 他一直是天主教徒中的团结者，而方济各则愿意说一些挑衅性的话。

sentences.en: Leo has been much more interested in smoothing things over with conservatives who didn't take kindly to some of Francis's more unorthodox actions.
sentences.zh: 利奥一直更热衷于与那些对方济各一些非正统行为不满的保守派缓和关系。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: He seems to really take seriously that he is the pope for everyone, and that's why he speaks to everyone.
sentences.zh: 他似乎真的很认真地对待自己是所有人的教皇这一身份，这就是为什么他与每个人对话。

sentences.en: So given that he's not been a partisan pope thus far, that is why, when he actually went up against Trump, that it really felt like a very significant moment.
sentences.zh: 所以鉴于他迄今为止还不是一位党派色彩浓厚的教皇，这就是为什么当他真正对抗特朗普时，感觉确实是一个非常重要的时刻。

sentences.en: So as if things were intense enough,
sentences.zh: 所以，仿佛局势还不够紧张，

sentences.en: we land and we turn on our phones and we see that the president has now posted an AI-generated image of himself that clearly looks like he's trying to appear as Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 我们落地打开手机，看到总统发布了一张自己的人工智能生成图像，看起来他显然是在试图表现得像耶稣基督。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·洛。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the reaction to all of this, to Trump's attacks on the pope, the pope's response,
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈对这一切的反应，对特朗普攻击教皇、教皇的回应，

sentences.en: and then this very provocative image that Trump posts of himself as a Jesus figure.
sentences.zh: 以及特朗普发布的这张将自己描绘成耶稣形象的极具挑衅性的图片。

sentences.en: So I think the response to President Trump's attack on the pope, certainly from Catholics, was pretty outraged.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为对特朗普总统攻击教皇的反应，当然来自天主教徒，是非常愤怒的。

sentences.en: They thought this was very inappropriate for the president of the United States to attack, you know, who they consider to be the vicar of Christ, the leader of their church,
sentences.zh: 他们认为美国总统攻击他们心目中的基督代理人、他们教会的领袖是非常不恰当的，

sentences.en: a spiritual leader who should be above all politicians.
sentences.zh: 一位应该凌驾于所有政客之上的精神领袖。

sentences.en: There was certainly a lot of pushback from around the world, even including from Iran, saying that this was unacceptable and rude.
sentences.zh: 世界各地当然有很多反对声音，甚至包括伊朗，称这是不可接受且粗鲁的。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Maloney of Italy said that Trump's attack on the pope were completely unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 意大利总理梅洛尼表示，特朗普对教皇的攻击是完全不可接受的。

sentences.en: So there's definitely been pushback around the world, not just among the Catholic faithful, but political leaders as well.
sentences.zh: 所以世界各地肯定都有反对声音，不仅是在天主教信徒中，在政治领导人中也是如此。

sentences.en: As for the image that President Trump posted after attacking the pope, he looked like he was trying to look like Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 至于特朗普总统在攻击教皇后发布的图片，他看起来像是试图让自己看起来像耶稣基督。

sentences.en: He's got a light in his hand, he's blessing a patient who looks very sick, and there's light radiating out of the patient's head,
sentences.zh: 他手里拿着光，正在祝福一位看起来病得很重的病人，病人的头上放射出光芒，

sentences.en: and it looks like he's up in heaven with these very angel-like figures in the sky.
sentences.zh: 看起来他正和天空中这些非常像天使的人物一起在天堂里。

sentences.en: I want to show you an image that President Trump posted on his Truth Social yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我想给你们看一张特朗普总统昨天在他的“真实社交”上发布的图片。

sentences.en: What do you make of this?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: That's disgusting.
sentences.zh: 那太恶心了。

sentences.en: And this really sparked outrage, and that outrage seemed much broader.
sentences.zh: 这确实引发了愤怒，而且这种愤怒似乎更加广泛。

sentences.en: It was not just Catholics who were upset about it, but many, many Christians, including evangelical Christians.
sentences.zh: 不仅是天主教徒对此感到不安，许多许多基督徒，包括福音派基督徒也是如此。

sentences.en: As a Christian, I was very offended.
sentences.zh: 作为一名基督徒，我感到非常被冒犯。

sentences.en: That's a disgrace.
sentences.zh: 那是一种耻辱。

sentences.en: I mean, how egotistical can you possibly be?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一个人怎么能自负到这种地步？

sentences.en: I'm ashamed that he would actually do that.
sentences.zh: 我为他竟然会做出这种事感到羞耻。

sentences.en: The man I voted for and truSt.
sentences.zh: 那个我投票支持并信任的人。

sentences.en: Jesus Christ is my Lord and Savior, and that right there is, I mean, that's, I don't really have words for that.
sentences.zh: 耶稣基督是我的主和救主，而那张图片，我的意思是，那，我真的无法用言语来形容。

sentences.en: I thought that was blasphemy.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是亵渎。

sentences.en: Blasphemy.
sentences.zh: 亵渎。

sentences.en: That is blasphemy in its purest form.
sentences.zh: 那是纯粹形式的亵渎。

sentences.en: There seemed to be a much broader sense that this was bordering on sacrilegious, not just inappropriate or unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 人们似乎有一种更广泛的感觉，认为这近乎亵渎神明，而不仅仅是不恰当或不可接受。

sentences.en: You're mocking my Lord and Savior, Jesus ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 你在嘲笑我的主和救主，耶稣基督。

sentences.en: He's mocking him.
sentences.zh: 他在嘲笑他。

sentences.en: It shows a flippancy towards what's really essential and important about our relationship with God.
sentences.zh: 这显示出一种轻浮，对待我们与上帝关系中真正本质和重要的事情。

sentences.en: And God will not be mocked.
sentences.zh: 上帝是不可嘲弄的。

sentences.en: Mr. President, did you post that picture of yourself depicted as Jesus Christ?
sentences.zh: 总统先生，那张将你自己描绘成耶稣基督的照片是你发布的吗？

sentences.en: Well, it wasn't a picture.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那不是照片。

sentences.en: It was me.
sentences.zh: 那是我。

sentences.en: I did post it, and I thought it was me as a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我确实发布了它，我以为那是我作为一名医生。

sentences.en: President Trump, it should be said, claimed that he did not think that he was trying to make himself look like Jesus,
sentences.zh: 应该说，特朗普总统声称他并不认为自己是在试图让自己看起来像耶稣，

sentences.en: but that he was trying to look like a doctor who helped people.
sentences.zh: 而是试图看起来像一位帮助人们的医生。

sentences.en: And had to do with Red Cross as a Red Cross worker there, which we support.
sentences.zh: 这与红十字会有关，作为那里的红十字会工作人员，我们支持这一点。

sentences.en: But he said it was a picture of him as a doctor?
sentences.zh: 但他说是他作为医生的照片？

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was wondering what the people that you're surrounded by right now on this papal trip made of that argument by Trump.
sentences.zh: 是的，我很好奇你现在在这次教皇之行中身边的人对特朗普的这种论点有何看法。

sentences.en: Did they buy that?
sentences.zh: 他们相信吗？

sentences.en: No, I have not heard anyone who thinks he looks like a doctor.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有听到任何人认为他看起来像医生。

sentences.en: I think everyone got the images alluding to him as a Jesus figure.
sentences.zh: 我认为每个人都看出了这些暗示他是耶稣形象的图片。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I want to ask about a particular group of Catholics, and that is the Catholics inside the Trump administration, and particularly about J.D.
sentences.zh: 所以我想问关于一群特定的天主教徒，那就是特朗普政府内部的天主教徒，特别是关于J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, the vice president, the most prominent Catholic in the administration.
sentences.zh: 万斯，副总统，政府中最杰出的天主教徒。

sentences.en: What has he said?
sentences.zh: 他说了什么？

sentences.en: Well, that's where the surprise continues.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是惊喜持续的地方。

sentences.en: So as a Catholic, what does it feel like to be, you know, in the middle of that?
sentences.zh: 那么作为一名天主教徒，身处其中是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I thought it was going to get easy questions.
sentences.zh: 我以为会遇到简单的问题。

sentences.en: And it looks like the administration really is doubling down on its antagonistic approach to the pope.
sentences.zh: 看起来政府确实在加倍采取对教皇的对抗态度。

sentences.en: But he said that God is never on the side of those who wield the sword.
sentences.zh: 但他却说上帝从不站在挥舞刀剑的人一边。

sentences.en: He seemed like he was almost schooling the pope on Catholic theology and making an argument about the theory of a just war.
sentences.zh: 他看起来几乎是在教导教皇天主教神学，并就正义战争理论提出了一个论点。

sentences.en: How can you say that God is never on the side of those who wield the sword?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能说上帝从不站在挥舞刀剑的人一边？

sentences.en: Was God on the side of the Americans who liberated France from the Nazis?
sentences.zh: 上帝站在从纳粹手中解放法国的美国人一边吗？

sentences.en: Was God on the side of the Americans who liberated Holocaust camps and liberated those who had survived the Holocaust?
sentences.zh: 上帝站在解放大屠杀集中营并解放那些在大屠杀中幸存下来的人的美国人一边吗？

sentences.en: And clearly, the vice president, as has the president, are trying to argue that the attack on Iran is a just war in a Christian sense, not just in a political or moral sense.
sentences.zh: 显然，副总统和总统一样，正试图辩称对伊朗的攻击在基督教意义上是一场正义的战争，而不仅仅是在政治或道德意义上。

sentences.en: You know, each of us has our own role.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们每个人都有自己的角色。

sentences.en: I'm the vice president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我是美国副总统。

sentences.en: The pope's job is to preach the gospel.
sentences.zh: 教皇的工作是宣扬福音。

sentences.en: And then he said that the pope should just stick to matters that concern the church.
sentences.zh: 然后他说教皇应该只关注与教会有关的事情。

sentences.en: I think it's very, very important for the pope to be careful when he talks about matters of theology.
sentences.zh: 我认为教皇在谈论神学问题时必须非常非常小心。

sentences.en: If you're going to opine on matters of theology, you've got to be careful.
sentences.zh: 如果你要对神学问题发表意见，你必须小心。

sentences.en: You've got to make sure it's anchored in the truth.
sentences.zh: 你必须确保它植根于真理。

sentences.en: It's peculiar for the vice president of the United States, a recent convert to Catholicism, to be trying to lecture the pope,
sentences.zh: 对于美国副总统，一位最近皈依天主教的人来说，试图教导教皇，

sentences.en: who has been a Catholic all his life and is the leader of the Catholic Church, on Catholic theology.
sentences.zh: 一位终身信奉天主教并担任天主教会领袖的人，关于天主教神学的知识，这很奇怪。

sentences.en: But that seems to be what he is doing.
sentences.zh: 但这似乎正是他正在做的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It is kind of stunning to hear any politician try to tell the pope how to speak about theology.
sentences.zh: 听到任何政客试图告诉教皇如何谈论神学，确实令人震惊。

sentences.en: I do think that Vance's argument here, if I understand it, is that, look, this war is moral.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为万斯在这里的论点，如果我理解正确的话，是说，看，这场战争是道德的。

sentences.en: He specifically said, you know, wouldn't the pope have blessed American fighters liberating France from the Nazis?
sentences.zh: 他特别说，你知道，教皇难道不会祝福从纳粹手中解放法国的美国战士吗？

sentences.en: I'm wondering, what do you think the pope's response to that would be?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，你认为教皇对此会有什么回应？

sentences.en: I know you're not inside his head, but help me understand what you think his position is.
sentences.zh: 我知道你不是他肚子里的蛔虫，但请帮我理解你认为他的立场是什么。

sentences.en: I think the pope would likely say something like, this war does not qualify as a just war.
sentences.zh: 我认为教皇可能会说类似的话，这场战争不符合正义战争的条件。

sentences.en: In that, he is joined by many global leaders who say this is a war of choice, not a war of necessity.
sentences.zh: 在这方面，他与许多全球领导人一致，他们认为这是一场选择性的战争，而不是一场必要的战争。

sentences.en: There isn't a sense that the war is actually about liberating innocent people.
sentences.zh: 人们并不觉得这场战争真的是为了解放无辜的人。

sentences.en: And the pope has made the point.
sentences.zh: 教皇已经指出了这一点。

sentences.en: Someone needs to speak up for the innocent people who are getting killed in this war.
sentences.zh: 必须有人为在这场战争中被杀害的无辜民众发声。

sentences.en: And has the pope weighed in on the argument that this Iranian regime has been extremely repressive toward its own people and that regime change would benefit them,
sentences.zh: 那么教皇是否对伊朗政权一直对其本国人民进行极其压迫，而政权更迭将使他们受益这一论点发表过看法，

sentences.en: that that's what the Trump administration is trying to do?
sentences.zh: 即这就是特朗普政府试图做的事情？

sentences.en: I don't know if he's directly weighed in on that point specifically about Iran, but more broadly, he's not saying that he's against just moral actions.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是否直接就伊朗这一点发表过看法，但更广泛地说，他并不是说他反对正义的道德行动。

sentences.en: He's just saying he's against war.
sentences.zh: 他只是说他反对战争。

sentences.en: So he keeps emphasizing dialogue as a way to get to the goals.
sentences.zh: 所以他一直强调对话是实现目标的途径。

sentences.en: It doesn't seem like he's saying who cares about the protesters, who cares about the nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 他似乎并不是说谁在乎抗议者，谁在乎核武器。

sentences.en: It's just saying there are other ways to get to these goals.
sentences.zh: 他只是说还有其他方法可以实现这些目标。

sentences.en: And what about Vance's claim that this is just not the pope's realm to engage in politics?
sentences.zh: 那么万斯声称这不是教皇参与政治的领域，你怎么看？

sentences.en: Obviously, this is the pope weighing in on a war, not on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 显然，这是教皇在就一场战争发表意见，而不是在就美国，

sentences.en: midterms, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如中期选举发表意见。

sentences.en: But what do you make of that criticism?
sentences.zh: 但你对这种批评有何看法？

sentences.en: Well, I think in some respects, this probably is a fair criticism for a politician or a government leader to say, don't meddle in our internal decisions.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为在某些方面，对于政客或政府领导人来说，说“不要干涉我们的内部决策”，这或许是一个合理的批评。

sentences.en: We're a sovereign nation.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个主权国家。

sentences.en: And the Vatican City is also a sovereign state, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，梵蒂冈城也是一个主权国家。

sentences.en: But I think in this case, the way the pope views it is that it's a very fundamental principle of Christianity.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在这种情况下，教皇的看法是，这是基督教的一个非常根本的原则。

sentences.en: We are the peacemakers.
sentences.zh: 我们是和平的缔造者。

sentences.en: And so I think the pope takes that very seriously.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为教皇非常严肃地对待这一点。

sentences.en: The Trump administration, on the other hand, seems to want to keep up the fight, or it almost seems like they're trying to persuade the pope.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，特朗普政府似乎想继续这场争斗，或者看起来他们几乎是在试图说服教皇。

sentences.en: The president posted again on social media that someone should tell Leo about the 42,000 protesters who've died in Iran.
sentences.zh: 总统再次在社交媒体上发帖称，应该有人告诉利奥教皇，伊朗有42000名抗议者死亡。

sentences.en: Those are not verified numbers as far as I know.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这些数字并未得到证实。

sentences.en: But it's not like he's just sort of saying, oh, Pope Leo is lame.
sentences.zh: 但他并不是那种随口说“哦，利奥教皇真差劲”的人。

sentences.en: He's weak on crime again.
sentences.zh: 他又在说他打击犯罪不力了。

sentences.en: He's really making an argument, which I think is a slight shift in tone, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 他确实是在进行辩论，我认为这在语气上有了些许转变。

sentences.en: Yeah, it does seem like they really care about how this war is perceived and about ensuring that it's perceived as just morally and in every other way.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们确实非常在意这场战争是如何被看待的，并确保它在道德和其他各方面都被视为正义的。

sentences.en: Well, they're certainly trying to make a case to persuade the American people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们当然是在试图寻找理由来说服美国人民。

sentences.en: This is not just about religion.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是关于宗教的问题。

sentences.en: This is clearly something that's happening on the political realm as well.
sentences.zh: 这显然也是在政治领域发生的事情。

sentences.en: But inasmuch as the pope is the leader of a group that represents something like over 50 million people in the United States, identify as Catholic, I think the last figures show,
sentences.zh: 但鉴于教皇是一个代表了美国超过5000万自认为是天主教徒的群体的领袖，我想最新的数据显示，

sentences.en: they're an important constituency for the president.
sentences.zh: 他们是总统的重要选民群体。

sentences.en: We've talked on the show, Motoko, about how the justifications for this war from the Trump administration have been a little all over the place.
sentences.zh: Motoko，我们在节目中讨论过，特朗普政府对这场战争的辩解一直有些混乱。

sentences.en: A lot of the messaging has basically been, we are trying to cause as much damage as possible in Iran.
sentences.zh: 很多信息传递基本上都是：我们正在试图在伊朗造成尽可能大的破坏。

sentences.en: We are winning, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 我们正在获胜，等等。

sentences.en: But to the extent that they have invoked moral justification to the American public, it has been tied to religious and specifically Christian values.
sentences.zh: 但就他们向美国公众援引道德辩护的程度而言，这与宗教，特别是基督教价值观联系在一起。

sentences.en: Trump invoked this Easter miracle when that airman was rescued in Iran.
sentences.zh: 当那名飞行员在伊朗获救时，特朗普援引了这次“复活节奇迹”。

sentences.en: You know, Hegseth has told people to pray, as you said.
sentences.zh: 你知道，正如你所说，赫格塞斯（Hegseth）曾告诉人们要祈祷。

sentences.en: And so I wonder if there is some real impact for the administration of having that argument be countered so forcefully by the pope.
sentences.zh: 所以我怀疑，这种论点被教皇如此有力地反驳，是否会对政府产生真正的冲击。

sentences.en: He is the most recognized Christian leader on earth.
sentences.zh: 他是地球上最广为人知的基督教领袖。

sentences.en: That is a fact.
sentences.zh: 这是一个事实。

sentences.en: There are other Christian leaders, the head of the Anglican Church, but he is the most recognized.
sentences.zh: 还有其他基督教领袖，比如英国国教的领袖，但他才是最广为人知的。

sentences.en: In fact, I think it's probably fair to say that maybe aside from the Dalai Lama, that he's the most recognized spiritual leader on earth.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为公平地说，除了达赖喇嘛之外，他可能是地球上最广为人知的精神领袖。

sentences.en: And so to have him counter what is one of their chief arguments for going to war so forcefully is very powerful and perhaps threatening.
sentences.zh: 因此，让他如此有力地反驳他们发动战争的主要论点之一，是非常有影响力的，甚至可能是具有威胁性的。

sentences.en: How much do you think it matters that Pope Leo is an American?
sentences.zh: 你认为利奥教皇是美国人这一点有多重要？

sentences.en: Like, how much of a factor do you think that is for Trump as he thinks about how to respond and as he processes this active and ongoing criticism?
sentences.zh: 比如，你认为在特朗普思考如何回应以及处理这种积极且持续的批评时，这是一个多大的因素？

sentences.en: Well, I think the fact that Pope Leo is from the United States makes it difficult for the administration to discount his views.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为利奥教皇来自美国这一事实，使得政府很难忽视他的观点。

sentences.en: They cannot, like, as they might with Pope Francis or any other previous pope, say, look, this guy just doesn't get us.
sentences.zh: 他们不能像对待方济各教皇或任何前任教皇那样说：看，这家伙根本不了解我们。

sentences.en: We're different.
sentences.zh: 我们是不一样的。

sentences.en: Or this is how American politics works.
sentences.zh: 或者这就是美国政治的运作方式。

sentences.en: They can't really say that with this pope because he's from the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们不能对这位教皇这样说，因为他来自美国。

sentences.en: He was born in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 他出生在芝加哥。

sentences.en: He's from the Midwest, the heartland.
sentences.zh: 他来自中西部，也就是心脏地带。

sentences.en: This is a guy who deeply understands partisan politics in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是一个深刻理解美国党派政治的人。

sentences.en: He's much harder to dismiss.
sentences.zh: 他更难被驳回。

sentences.en: What about for the pope himself?
sentences.zh: 那对教皇本人来说呢？

sentences.en: I know when Pope Leo first became pope, there was this worry about whether his Americanness would drag him into politics in a way that would be ugly and unseemly,
sentences.zh: 我知道当利奥教皇刚成为教皇时，人们担心他的“美国性”是否会以一种丑陋且不得体的方式将他拖入政治，

sentences.en: not something the church wanted.
sentences.zh: 这不是教会想要的。

sentences.en: And now here we are.
sentences.zh: 现在我们到了这里。

sentences.en: We've arrived at that point, it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 看来我们已经到了那个节点。

sentences.en: So do you think he is considering his American identity when he thinks about how to respond?
sentences.zh: 那么你认为他在考虑如何回应时，是否在考量自己的美国身份？

sentences.en: Well, like I said, I can't be inside the pope's head.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像我说的，我无法进入教皇的内心。

sentences.en: And he has famously told the press corps that every time you think you know what I'm thinking, you don't.
sentences.zh: 而且他曾向媒体界名言道：每当你以为你知道我在想什么时，你其实并不知道。

sentences.en: That being said, how can it not be part of his thinking as a human being?
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，作为一个人，这怎么可能不成为他思考的一部分呢？

sentences.en: He comes from the United States.
sentences.zh: 他来自美国。

sentences.en: His family is there.
sentences.zh: 他的家人在那里。

sentences.en: However, I do think he's already showing signs of how he reacts, which is he said what he had to say on the plane on Monday,
sentences.zh: 不过，我确实认为他已经表现出他反应方式的迹象，那就是他在周一的飞机上说了他该说的话，

sentences.en: but he did come back to talk to us on the flight from Algiers to the capital of Cameroon.
sentences.zh: 但他确实在从阿尔及尔飞往喀麦隆首都的航班上回来和我们交谈了。

sentences.en: And he did not take questions this time.
sentences.zh: 这次他没有接受提问。

sentences.en: He did not walk the aisles.
sentences.zh: 他没有走过过道。

sentences.en: But he talked about how much joy he had had and the visit in Algiers,
sentences.zh: 但他谈到了他在阿尔及尔访问期间有多么快乐，

sentences.en: and he talked about being in a majority Muslim country and being in a place where we could learn the lessons of unity, of respecting difference, of living together in peace.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了身处一个穆斯林占多数的国家，身处一个我们可以学习团结、尊重差异、和平共处这些课程的地方。

sentences.en: He definitely used that word.
sentences.zh: 他确实用了那个词。

sentences.en: So I think that he's sort of returning to his oblique style where he talks about his primary values, and he is going to let that speak for itself.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他正在回归他那种含蓄的风格，谈论他核心的价值观，并让这些价值观不言自明。

sentences.en: He's not taking the bait, you're saying, to, once he's been dragged in, stay there in the muck.
sentences.zh: 你是说他没有上钩，一旦被拖下水，就不会留在泥潭里。

sentences.en: He's trying, it sounds like, to rise above again.
sentences.zh: 听起来他正在试图再次超脱出来。

sentences.en: I mean, it's only been a few days, so I don't want to read too much into that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，才过了几天，所以我不想对此过度解读。

sentences.en: But this was a moment where we were wondering, is he going to address these comments?
sentences.zh: 但这确实是一个我们都在想：他会回应这些评论吗？的时刻。

sentences.en: The pope could have responded, but he didn't.
sentences.zh: 教皇本可以回应，但他没有。

sentences.en: In politics, by the way, that's called message discipline, which is not something Trump has displayed very often.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，在政治上，这被称为“信息纪律”，而这并不是特朗普经常表现出来的东西。

sentences.en: If there's one word we can use about Pope Leo, it is definitely disciplined.
sentences.zh: 如果有一个词可以用来形容利奥教皇，那绝对是“自律”。

sentences.en: You know, it strikes me that in that, whether Pope Leo likes it or not, he is a very obvious foil for Trump.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这让我印象深刻，无论利奥教皇是否喜欢，他都是特朗普非常明显的对照物。

sentences.en: This may not be something he wanted to claim, being the anti-Trump, but now it seems like maybe he can't avoid it.
sentences.zh: 这可能不是他想要宣称的身份，成为“反特朗普者”，但现在看来他似乎无法避免。

sentences.en: I think whether he likes it or not is absolutely accurate, that most likely he does not.
sentences.zh: 我认为无论他是否喜欢，这个说法绝对准确，他很可能并不喜欢。

sentences.en: Again, I sound like I'm speaking for him, but that is what people who surround him, that is how he's behaved from the beginning, that he didn't want this role.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我听起来像是在替他说话，但这就是他身边的人所说的，也是他从一开始的行为方式，他并不想要这个角色。

sentences.en: But how one is perceived as a leader is also important, and I think he is aware of that.
sentences.zh: 但一个人作为领导者如何被看待也很重要，我认为他意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: And so if the moment has called him to play this role, he seems willing and certainly not afraid of stepping into it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果时机要求他扮演这个角色，他似乎愿意，而且肯定不害怕介入其中。

sentences.en: From everything that you said, Motoko, in describing the trajectory of this rift between the Pope and the president,
sentences.zh: Motoko，从你所说的一切，描述教皇与总统之间这种裂痕的轨迹来看，

sentences.en: it definitely seems as though Trump in this case rolled out his typical playbook for dealing with anyone who criticizes him.
sentences.zh: 在这件事上，特朗普似乎确实拿出了他应对任何批评他的人的典型剧本。

sentences.en: You know, he called the Pope names, he accused him of literally the exact thing that you would expect him to accuse a political opponent of, being weak on crime, for example.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他给教皇起绰号，指责他，这正是你所预料的他会用来指责政治对手的那种话，例如打击犯罪不力。

sentences.en: This is like his go-to move for a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 这就像他针对民主党人的惯用招数。

sentences.en: But Pope Leo is not that.
sentences.zh: 但利奥教皇不是那样的人。

sentences.en: He's the leader of 1.4 billion Catholics around the world who view him as the representative of Jesus on Earth.
sentences.zh: 他是全球14亿天主教徒的领袖，他们视他为耶稣在世的代表。

sentences.en: And the fallout is reflective of that.
sentences.zh: 而后果也反映了这一点。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: He's not a politician.
sentences.zh: 他不是政客。

sentences.en: He's elected for life, and he's not a leader of a particular country.
sentences.zh: 他是终身任职的，而且他不是某个特定国家的领导人。

sentences.en: I mean, in as much as he's head of state of Vatican City, that's not really his role.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，尽管他是梵蒂冈城的国家元首，但这并不是他真正的角色。

sentences.en: His role primarily as leader, as you said, of these 1.4 billion Catholics around the world, and they're in every country.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，他作为全球14亿天主教徒领袖的角色是主要的，而他们遍布每个国家。

sentences.en: I'm sure he thinks about wanting to be a leader for everyone rather than someone who is dividing the Catholic Church.
sentences.zh: 我相信他考虑的是想成为每个人的领袖，而不是分裂天主教会的人。

sentences.en: I think he also—I think it is fair to say that he is, first and foremost, a religious leader.
sentences.zh: 我认为他——我认为公平地说，他首先是一位宗教领袖。

sentences.en: That is his job.
sentences.zh: 那是他的工作。

sentences.en: That is his role.
sentences.zh: 那是他的角色。

sentences.en: That is his calling.
sentences.zh: 那是他的使命。

sentences.en: And so politics is something that sometimes happens to him as much as that he is engaging in.
sentences.zh: 所以政治有时是发生在他身上的事情，和他正在参与的事情一样多。

sentences.en: In some ways, the fight has been unavoidable, not because he's sought it out, but because he's been consistent in the values that he preaches.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这场争斗是不可避免的，不是因为他寻求争斗，而是因为他在所宣扬的价值观上始终如一。

sentences.en: And he really sticks to his message about peace and unity and using dialogue.
sentences.zh: 他确实坚持关于和平、团结和使用对话的信息。

sentences.en: That message seems to have triggered the Trump administration, which really craves the approval of a Christian leader to justify their actions.
sentences.zh: 那个信息似乎触怒了特朗普政府，他们非常渴望得到一位基督教领袖的认可来证明他们行动的合理性。

sentences.en: And the fight has come to him.
sentences.zh: 而争斗找上了他。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It seems like no matter how much Trump wants the Pope's approval, he's finding that he can't intimidate this Pope to change his position like he can with many other global leaders.
sentences.zh: 看起来无论特朗普多么渴望得到教皇的认可，他发现自己无法像对待其他许多全球领导人那样恐吓这位教皇来改变立场。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: I think a lot of global leaders up until very recently have tried to appease the president in some way by negotiating or compromising or watering down their actual opinions to keep him from getting angry because he has the power to retaliate in tariffs or withdrawing support or aid.
sentences.zh: 我认为直到最近，许多全球领导人都试图通过谈判、妥协或淡化他们的真实观点来安抚总统，以防止他生气，因为他有权通过关税、撤回支持或援助进行报复。

sentences.en: He doesn't really have that power over the Vatican.
sentences.zh: 但他对梵蒂冈并没有那种权力。

sentences.en: He can't unseat this leader.
sentences.zh: 他无法罢免这位领袖。

sentences.en: He can't make him so unpopular that voters vote him out.
sentences.zh: 他无法让他变得如此不受欢迎以至于选民把他选下去。

sentences.en: So in some ways, this is a unique situation in that this is not a leader that can be intimidated, as you say.
sentences.zh: 所以在某些方面，这是一个独特的情况，因为正如你所说，这不是一个可以被恐吓的领导人。

sentences.en: And he has shown himself personally as speaking forcefully and saying he's not afraid.
sentences.zh: 而且他亲自表现出有力地发言，并表示他不害怕。

sentences.en: Well, Motoko, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，Motoko，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Good luck on the rest of the trip.
sentences.zh: 祝你余下的旅程顺利。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
